execution.reason: The policy scaffold and its tests establish the reusable contract before the init prompt consumes it; both tasks touch the same test file and must run sequentially.

tasks.title: Lock the reusable policy contract
tasks.description: The canonical scaffold and focused static tests define the mandatory kernel, evidence-derived boundaries, line budget, and forbidden project-specific assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: The scaffold contains authority, deletion, concurrent-work, Git-approval, targeted-edit, generated-source, evidence, and bounded-delegation categories, plus the complete destructive-action sequence: preflight, first confirmation, refreshed preflight, second immediate confirmation, exact execution, and audit.
The scaffold is at most 150 lines and favors pointers over copied workflow manuals.
The universal body contains no hardcoded package manager, runtime, primary branch, project verification command, target-project path, or unconditional optional-tool workflow.
Focused tests use semantic category assertions rather than an exact full-document snapshot.

tasks.title: Integrate evidence-backed policy synthesis into /init
tasks.description: The /init prompt explicitly consumes the scaffold, safely previews and merges existing instructions, bounds discovery, removes standing Git authorization, and reports context activation accurately.
acceptance_criteria: /init explicitly reads .pi/templates/agents-policy.md and distinguishes mandatory, project-detected, conditional, conflicting, and preserved-custom content.
/init validates project facts and requires both project/configuration evidence and executable validation before advertising optional workflow tools.
Existing AGENTS.md content is previewed and merged without blind replacement; custom rules are preserved unless they weaken a mandatory gate.

The generation contract limits newly created AGENTS.md files to 150 lines; when an existing file already exceeds the limit or cannot fit preserved content plus the kernel, /init preserves existing content, minimizes only generated additions, and reports the exception rather than truncating user-authored rules.
The user-profile flow does not offer standing auto-commit or automatic publication authorization.
Deep initialization caps concurrent agent waves at three, processes overflow sequentially, and stops when required decisions have sufficient evidence.
After AGENTS.md changes, /init instructs the user to run /reload or start a new session and does not claim the policy is already active.
All retained Pi Core tests pass without adding an extension, dependency, generator executable, or new runtime state.
verification: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern="init policy synthesis|init policy safety|init policy activation|init.*fan-out|fan-out.*init" .pi/tests/skill-system.test.ts
